title: A TAKEOVER KEEPS THE RAID FLOW
why: When the host window closes or loses its link, player 2 picks up the raid. His window had never planned the fires, the raid events or the run goals, because the host does that, so once it ran the raid it planned them all fresh at the current raid time: every fuel fire already due lit at once (including ones that had burnt out on the host), the events already played launched again (a second bounty, a second convoy), RUN GOALS was said again, and a convoy or bounty live at the moment of the takeover, whose bodies were only mirrors and were let go, read as killed: CONVOY DOWN with a free crate, or BOUNTY CLAIMED and 1,500. Proven in headless Chromium: a takeover at 200 s with the convoy live paid a crate and launched a new MACHINE CONVOY; at 235 s with the bounty live it paid 1,500 and launched a new BOUNTY PILLAGER; at 450 s, with both fires burnt out, both lit again with FUEL FIRE and RUN GOALS said. At the takeover the part of the plan already past is now marked done and a live convoy, bounty or rampage ends quietly with nothing paid; what is still to come in the raid runs on in his window.
now: When player 2 picks up the raid after the host drops, the fires and events that already happened no longer replay, and nothing is paid for a live convoy or bounty.
